info.name: Nudge — isolated simulation workflow
info.description: Run using scripts/check-postman-workflow.mjs only. Creates a disposable local server/database, never uses your ordinary workspace or integration credentials. AI and payments are simulated. No reset action, account signup, external API call or cloud monitor.

exec: const d = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Fresh demo with all real integrations disabled', () => { pm.expect(d.mode).to.eql('demo'); pm.expect(d.aiEnabled).to.eql(false); pm.expect(d.connections).to.deep.eql({paypal:false,ai:false,webhook:false}); pm.expect(d.version).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.agreementStatus).to.eql('draft'); pm.expect(d.proposals).to.have.lengthOf(0); pm.expect(d.invoices).to.have.lengthOf(0); });
const d = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Public decision view excludes owner records', () => { privateView(d); pm.expect(d.agreementStatus).to.eql('approved'); });

item.name: 07 Simulated scope draft has no price

exec: pm.test('Simulation creates one zero-price draft and no invoice', () => { pm.expect(d.proposals).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(p.analysis.source).to.eql('simulation'); pm.expect(p.status).to.eql('draft'); pm.expect(p.amountCents).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.invoices).to.have.lengthOf(0); });

exec: pm.test('Review recorded, draft still unpriced', () => { pm.expect(p.scopeReview.classification).to.eql('included'); pm.expect(p.amountCents).to.eql(0); pm.expect(p.status).to.eql('draft'); });

item.name: 11 Included work cannot be charged as extra

exec: pm.test('Server explains pricing block', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.include('Included or unclear'));

item.name: 13 Ambiguous work cannot be charged as extra

body.raw: {"type":"reviewScope","id":"{{proposal_id}}","expectedReviewId":"{{review_id}}","classification":"additional","rationale":"Booking systems are explicitly excluded by S3; quote only the requested new booking work.","references":["S3"],"clarification":"","deliverables":["Appointment booking with time slots"]}

exec: pm.test('Human additional decision preserves original analysis', () => { pm.expect(p.scopeReview.classification).to.eql('additional'); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(p.analysis)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('original_analysis')); });

body.raw: {"type":"approveProposal","id":"{{proposal_id}}","reviewId":"{{review_id}}","extrasConfirmed":true,"amountCents":30000,"deliverables":["Appointment booking with time slots","Included heading colour change"]}

exec: pm.test('Owner price is exact cents, acceptance still pending', () => { pm.expect(p.status).to.eql('approved'); pm.expect(p.amountCents).to.eql(30000); pm.expect(p.deliverables).to.deep.eql(["Appointment booking with time slots"]); pm.expect(d.invoices).to.have.lengthOf(0); });

const d = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Quote visible without owner analysis or scope review', () => { privateView(d); pm.expect(d.proposals).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(d.proposals[0].amountCents).to.eql(30000); pm.expect(d.proposals[0]).not.to.have.property('analysis'); pm.expect(d.proposals[0]).not.to.have.property('scopeReview'); });

item.name: 18 Invoice blocked before client accepts quote
19 Client acceptance cannot alter price or work

exec: const p = pm.response.json().proposals[0]; pm.test('Decision keeps the owner-approved quote', () => { pm.expect(p.status).to.eql('accepted'); pm.expect(p.amountCents).to.eql(30000); pm.expect(p.deliverables).to.deep.eql(["Appointment booking with time slots"]); });

const d = pm.response.json(), i = d.invoices[0]; pm.test('One draft invoice for exact reviewed amount', () => { pm.expect(d.invoices).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(i.id).to.match(/^SIM-/); pm.expect(i.status).to.eql('DRAFT'); pm.expect(i.amountCents).to.eql(30000); pm.expect(i.outstandingCents).to.eql(30000); }); pm.collectionVariables.set('invoice_id', i.id);
const i = pm.response.json().invoices[0]; pm.test('Approved amount and due match', () => { pm.expect(i.amountCents).to.eql(30000); pm.expect(i.outstandingCents).to.eql(30000); });

const i = pm.response.json().invoices[0]; pm.test('Paid has zero outstanding', () => { pm.expect(i.status).to.eql('PAID'); pm.expect(i.amountCents).to.eql(30000); pm.expect(i.outstandingCents).to.eql(0); });

item.name: 30 Final owner state retains all gates

exec: const d = pm.response.json(); pm.test('No duplicate invoice, price change, policy change or live integration', () => { pm.expect(d.mode).to.eql('demo'); pm.expect(d.aiEnabled).to.eql(false); pm.expect(d.connections).to.deep.eql({paypal:false,ai:false,webhook:false}); pm.expect(d.proposals).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(d.proposals[0].status).to.eql('accepted'); pm.expect(d.proposals[0].amountCents).to.eql(30000); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(d.proposals[0].analysis)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('original_analysis')); pm.expect(d.invoices).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(d.invoices[0].status).to.eql('PAID'); pm.expect(d.invoices[0].outstandingCents).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.invoices[0].reminders).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.policies).to.deep.eql({protectedClient:false,reminderLimit:3,cooldownDays:7}); pm.expect(d.processing).to.eql(undefined); });

item.name: 31 Final client view has zero due

exec: const d = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Client sees settled invoice without owner records', () => { privateView(d); pm.expect(d.invoices).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(d.invoices[0].status).to.eql('PAID'); pm.expect(d.invoices[0].outstandingCents).to.eql(0); });

item.name: 32 Capture financial baseline before delivery planning

exec: const d = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Accepted paid simulation is the delivery baseline', () => { pm.expect(d.agreementStatus).to.eql('accepted'); pm.expect(d.invoices).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(d.invoices[0].status).to.eql('PAID'); pm.expect(d.deliveryPlan).to.eql(undefined); }); pm.collectionVariables.set('delivery_owner_baseline', JSON.stringify(d));

item.name: 33 Read private minimal unconfigured delivery view

exec: const d = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Local read is uncached and omits owner secrets and invoice links', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.eql('no-store'); pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('unconfigured'); pm.expect(d.stateSource).to.eql('local-records'); pm.expect(d.remoteCheckedAt).to.eql(null); ['clientToken','agreement','policies','audit','connections','processing'].forEach(k => pm.expect(d).not.to.have.property(k)); d.invoices.forEach(i => { ['id','payUrl','recipientEmail'].forEach(k => pm.expect(i).not.to.have.property(k)); }); });

item.name: 35 Rejected origin did not change workspace

exec: pm.test('Workspace including audit and version is unchanged', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.deep.eql(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('delivery_owner_baseline'))));

item.name: 36 Stage initial internal plan without applying

exec: const d = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Preview is server identified and leaves original/current unapplied', () => { pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('ready'); pm.expect(d.plan.revision).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.plan.current).to.eql(null); pm.expect(d.plan.original).to.eql(null); pm.expect(d.previewStale).to.eql(false); pm.expect(d.plan.preview.candidate.snapshot.tasks[0].id).to.match(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/); pm.expect(d.plan.preview.candidate.snapshot.tasks[0].id).not.to.eql('new:website'); });

const d = pm.response.json(); const saved = {...d}; delete saved.asOf; pm.test('Rejected command left delivery view unchanged', () => pm.expect(saved).to.deep.eql(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('delivery_saved_view'))));

const d = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Original is recorded exactly once and current equals reviewed plan', () => { pm.expect(d.plan.revision).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.plan.preview).to.eql(undefined); pm.expect(d.plan.current.snapshot).to.deep.eql(d.plan.original.snapshot); pm.expect(d.plan.current.snapshot.tasks[0].duration).to.eql(3); pm.expect(d.plan.calendar.timezone).to.eql('Asia/Kolkata'); }); pm.collectionVariables.set('delivery_original', JSON.stringify(d.plan.original));

item.name: 41 Stage changed dates while original and current remain fixed

exec: const d = pm.response.json(); pm.test('One-day date impact remains a preview', () => { pm.expect(d.plan.original).to.deep.eql(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('delivery_original'))); pm.expect(d.plan.revision).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.plan.current.snapshot.tasks[0].duration).to.eql(3); pm.expect(d.plan.preview.candidate.snapshot.tasks[0].duration).to.eql(4); pm.expect(d.plan.preview.diff.finishDeltaCalendarDays).to.eql(1); });

item.name: 43 Stale apply did not mutate delivery plan

exec: const d = pm.response.json(); const saved = {...d}; delete saved.asOf; pm.test('Rejected command left delivery view unchanged', () => pm.expect(saved).to.deep.eql(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('delivery_saved_view'))));

item.name: 44 Discard changed preview without changing applied dates

exec: const d = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Discard retains original and applied revision', () => { pm.expect(d.plan.revision).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.plan.preview).to.eql(undefined); pm.expect(d.plan.original).to.deep.eql(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('delivery_original'))); pm.expect(d.plan.current.snapshot).to.deep.eql(d.plan.original.snapshot); });

item.name: 46 Client still sees paid work and no internal delivery plan

exec: const d = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Internal plan and owner records remain private', () => { ['deliveryPlan','audit','policies','clientToken','connections'].forEach(k => pm.expect(d).not.to.have.property(k)); pm.expect(d.invoices).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(d.invoices[0].status).to.eql('PAID'); pm.expect(d.invoices[0].outstandingCents).to.eql(0); });

item.name: 47 Delivery commands preserve full financial baseline and rejection audit

exec: const d = pm.response.json(); const baseline = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('delivery_owner_baseline')); pm.test('Only four valid delivery commands changed version and audit', () => { function finances({version,audit,deliveryPlan,...rest}) { return rest; } pm.expect(finances(d)).to.deep.eql(finances(baseline)); pm.expect(d.version).to.eql(baseline.version + 4); pm.expect(d.audit.length).to.eql(baseline.audit.length + 4); pm.expect(d.audit.slice(4)).to.deep.eql(baseline.audit); pm.expect(d.audit.slice(0,4).map(a => a.title)).to.deep.eql(['Delivery preview discarded','Delivery preview staged','Delivery plan applied','Delivery preview staged']); pm.expect(d.deliveryPlan.original).to.deep.eql(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('delivery_original'))); pm.expect(d.deliveryPlan.current.snapshot).to.deep.eql(d.deliveryPlan.original.snapshot); pm.expect(d.deliveryPlan.preview).to.eql(undefined); });
